meaning: stick or push something into something

english.note: Use 插 when pushing a pointed object into something.

exampleSentences.english: Just stick the key into the lock.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你將支鎖匙插入個鎖孔就得。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 zi1 so2 si4 caap3 jap6 go3 so2 hung2 zau6 dak1

english.note: Use 插 when something such as a flag or stake is pushed firmly into the ground or another surface.

exampleSentences.english: The workers plant the flag in the soil.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gung1 jan4 zoeng1 zi1 kei4 caap3 jap6 nai4 tou2
